legal.aboutLead: StatusPulse is a small, Arabic-first status page product: it records uptime checks, opens incidents automatically and publishes a calm page for customers.
legal.aboutWhatBody: This demo hosts the status page of Wasla Pay, a fictional Egyptian fintech. Wasla Pay is used only as a believable sample brand; it is not a real company or a real payment provider.
legal.aboutDemoBody: Every component, timestamp and incident on this page is synthetic and labelled as a demo build. The dataset resets automatically.
legal.contactBody: Questions about StatusPulse or this demo? Email us at:
legal.privacyLead: This policy describes the demo deployment. It is short on purpose.
legal.privacyDataBody: The status page is read-only and does not ask visitors to create an account. The admin console stores the operator email and a password hash locally. Status checks and incident updates are stored in a local SQLite database.
legal.privacyCookiesBody: A single HttpOnly session cookie is used after operator sign-in. There are no advertising, analytics or third-party cookies.
legal.privacySharingBody: No data is sent to a third-party analytics, advertising or tracking service. Optional webhook delivery is off by default.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: Check results are kept for 180 days, notifications for 90 days, and sessions expire after 7 days. Demo data is rebuilt automatically.
legal.privacyContactBody: For privacy questions about this demo, email hello@statuspulse.example.com.
legal.termsLead: These terms cover the demo deployment of StatusPulse.
legal.termsUseBody: Use the demo to explore the product. Do not use it to monitor systems you do not own, attempt to break the service, or enter real secrets.
legal.termsDemoBody: Wasla Pay, its components and all data on this deployment are fictional. No real payment service is represented. The demo is provided as-is without warranty.
legal.termsAvailabilityBody: This is not a production service. It may be stopped, reset or changed without notice, and no uptime commitment is made.
legal.termsLiabilityBody: To the extent permitted by law, the owner is not liable for any loss arising from use of this demo. Egyptian law applies to this demo deployment.
legal.helpLead: Short answers about the status page and its signals.
legal.faq1a: Green means operational, amber means degraded performance, red means an outage, and blue means planned maintenance.
legal.faq2q: How often does the page refresh?
legal.faq2a: Every 30 seconds. The timestamp at the top of the page shows when the data was last refreshed.
legal.faq3q: Where do incident updates come from?
legal.faq3a: Automatic checks open an incident when a component fails. The operator can add investigating, identified, monitoring and resolved updates.
legal.faq4q: Is Wasla Pay a real company?
legal.faq4a: No. Wasla Pay is a fictional brand used to demonstrate the status page. All data is synthetic.
legal.faq5q: How do I use the demo?
legal.faq5a: Open the sign-in page and choose “Try the demo”. The shared demo dataset resets automatically.
legal.changelogLead: What changed in this demo build.
legal.changelogV1Body: Public status page for Wasla Pay, 90-day uptime bars, incident history, maintenance windows, bilingual Arabic/English UI, operator console with monitors, incidents, notifications, activity log and security settings.
